translations.literal: Liu Yao again sent his envoy Guo Si and others with staff to appoint Le grand tutor, concurrent grand general, advanced fief to Zhao king, adding seven commanderies together with the prior twenty, with imperial escort, twelve tassels on the crown, golden-root chariot, six-horse team, like Cao Cao aiding Han precedent, lady as queen, heir as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yao offered Shi Le the full regalia of a Zhao king and Han-style regency honors.

sentences.zh: 勒舍人曹平樂因使留仕於曜，言於曜曰：「大司馬遣王脩等來，外表至虔，內覘大駕強弱，謀待脩之返，將輕襲乘輿。

translations.literal: Le's attendant Cao Pingle stayed behind to serve Yao because of the mission, and said to Yao, "The grand marshal sent Wang Xiu and others whose outer show is utmost sincerity but inwardly spy the strength of Your Majesty's host, plotting to wait for Xiu's return then lightly raid the imperial carriage."
translations.idiomatic: Cao Pingle slandered Wang Xiu as a spy to Liu Yao.

sentences.zh: 」時曜勢實殘弊，懼脩宣之。

translations.literal: At the time Yao's power was truly broken and worn; he feared Xiu would report it.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yao, weak and paranoid, believed the tale.

sentences.zh: 曜大怒，追汜等還，斬脩-{于}-粟邑，停太宰之授。

translations.literal: Yao was greatly angry, recalled Si and others, beheaded Xiu at Suyi, halted the grand tutor investiture -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yao recalled his envoys, killed Wang Xiu at Suyi, and tore up the patent -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 劉茂逃歸，言王脩死故，勒大怒，誅平樂三族，贈脩太常。

translations.literal: Liu Mao fled back and reported the reason of Wang Xiu's death; Le was greatly angry, executed Pingle's three clans, posthumously invested Xiu minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mao brought news; Shi Le slaughtered Cao Pingle's kin and ennobled Wang Xiu posthumously.

sentences.zh: 又知停殊禮之授，怒甚，下令曰：「孤兄弟之奉劉家，人臣之道過矣，若微孤兄弟，豈能南面稱朕哉！

translations.literal: Knowing also that the extraordinary rites were halted, he was extremely angry and issued an order saying, "We brothers in serving the Liu house exceeded the way of ministers; if not for us brothers, how could he face south and style himself emperor!
translations.idiomatic: He published a rant that the Lius owed him everything.

sentences.zh: 根基旣立，便欲相圖。

translations.literal: The root and foundation already set, he then wished to plot against us.
translations.idiomatic: Once secure, Liu Yao turned on his benefactors.

sentences.zh: 天不助惡，使假手靳準。

translations.literal: Heaven did not aid evil, letting Jin Zhun strike by proxy.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven used Jin Zhun as its whip.

sentences.zh: 孤惟事君之體當資舜求瞽瞍之義，故復推崇令主，齊好如初，何圖長惡不悛，殺奉誠之使。

translations.literal: We thought the body serving a ruler ought to aid Shun seeking Gusou's righteousness, therefore again exalted the lawful lord and matched goodwill as at first—who expected him to cling to evil unrepentant and kill envoys who bore sincerity!
translations.idiomatic: He feigned moral language then listed Liu Yao's treachery.

sentences.zh: 帝王之起，復何常邪！

translations.literal: When emperors rise, is there again a constant!
translations.idiomatic: Thrones have never followed one rule.

sentences.zh: 趙王、趙帝，孤自取之，名號大小，豈其所節邪！

translations.literal: Zhao king, Zhao emperor—we will take them ourselves; great or small title, how can he constrain us!"
translations.idiomatic: He vowed to seize the Zhao title himself.

sentences.zh: 」於是置太醫、尚方、御府諸令，命參軍鼂讚成正陽門。

translations.literal: Thereupon he established overseers of grand physicians, imperial workshops, and imperial treasury, ordered adjutant Chao Zan to complete the Zhengyang gate.
translations.idiomatic: He set up palace offices and tasked Chao Zan with rebuilding Zhengyang Gate.

sentences.zh: 俄而門崩，勒大怒，斬讚。

translations.literal: Soon the gate collapsed; Le was greatly angry and beheaded Zan.
translations.idiomatic: The gate fell; Shi Le executed Chao Zan.

sentences.zh: 旣怒刑倉卒，尋亦悔之，賜以棺服，贈大鴻臚。

translations.literal: Though angry and punishing in haste, soon he also regretted it, granted coffin and robes, posthumously invested grand herald.
translations.idiomatic: He regretted the rash execution and buried Chao Zan with honors.

sentences.zh: 平西將軍祖逖攻陳川-{于}-蓬關，石季龍救川，逖退屯梁國，季龍使揚武左伏肅攻之。

translations.literal: General who pacifies the west Zu Ti attacked Chen Chuan at Pengguan; Shi Jilong relieved Chuan; Ti withdrew to encamp at Liang commandery; Jilong sent Zuo Fusu of displaying might to attack him -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Ti besieged Chen Chuan; Shi Jilong relieved the town and sent Zuo Fusu after Zu Ti -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 勒增置宣文、宣教、崇儒、崇訓十餘小學-{于}-襄國四門，簡將佐豪右子弟百餘人以教之，且備擊柝之衛。

translations.literal: Le added more than ten small schools of propagating culture, propagating instruction, exalting Confucians, exalting training at the four gates of Xiangguo, selecting over a hundred sons of officers and powerful households to teach them, and also to serve as night-watch guard -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: He opened village schools at Xiangguo's gates for officers' sons and night watchmen -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 置挈壺署，鑄豐貨錢。

translations.literal: He established the clepsydra office and cast abundant-goods coin.
translations.idiomatic: He founded a water-clock bureau and minted Feng huo cash.

sentences.zh: 河西鮮卑日六延叛-{于}-勒，石季龍討之，敗延-{于}-朔方，斬首二萬級，俘三萬餘人，獲牛馬十餘萬。

translations.literal: Hexi Xianbei Riziyan rebelled against Le; Shi Jilong campaigned against him, defeated Riziyan at Shuofang, cut off twenty thousand heads, captured more than thirty thousand persons, took more than a hundred thousand oxen and sheep -{yu}- -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: Riziyan of the Hexi Xianbei rose; Shi Jilong crushed him at Shuofang with vast captives -{yu}- -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 孔萇討平幽州諸郡。

translations.literal: Kong Chang campaigned to pacify the various commanderies of Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Chang swept the Youzhou counties quiet.

sentences.zh: 時段匹磾部衆饑散，棄其妻子，匹磾奔邵續。

translations.literal: At the time Duan Pidi's host starved and scattered; he abandoned wife and children; Pidi fled to Shao Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Pidi's army melted; he abandoned his family and ran to Shao Xu.

sentences.zh: 曹嶷遣使來聘，獻其方物，請以河為斷。

translations.literal: Cao Yi sent envoys to open court, presented local tribute, and begged to take the Yellow River as boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Yi sued for peace and a river border.

sentences.zh: 桃豹至蓬關，祖逖退如淮南。

translations.literal: Tao Bao reached Pengguan; Zu Ti withdrew toward Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Bao took Pengguan and pushed Zu Ti back toward the Huai.

sentences.zh: 徙陳川部衆五千餘戶-{于}-廣宗。

translations.literal: He moved more than five thousand households of Chen Chuan's department to Guangzong -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: He relocated five thousand of Chen Chuan's people to Guangzong -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 石季龍與張敬、張賓及諸將佐百餘人勸勒稱尊號，勒下書曰：「孤猥以寡德，忝荷崇寵，夙夜戰惶，如臨深薄，豈可假尊竊號，取譏四方！

translations.literal: Shi Jilong with Zhang Jing, Zhang Bin and more than a hundred generals and adjutants urged Le to assume the exalted title; Le issued an order saying, "I basely with scant virtue have disgracefully borne lofty favour; day and night I tremble as if on the brink of a deep abyss—how could I borrow a false lofty title and invite ridicule from the four quarters!"
translations.idiomatic: His court begged him to take the throne; he refused with a show of terror.

sentences.zh: 昔周文以三分之重，猶服事殷朝；

translations.literal: In old days King Wen of Zhou with the weight of the tripartition still served the Yin court.
translations.idiomatic: He cited King Wen still serving Shang.

sentences.zh: 小白居一匡之盛，而尊崇周室。

translations.literal: Little White dwelt in the fullness of one hegemon's correction yet honoured and revered the Zhou house.
translations.idiomatic: He cited Duke Huan bowing to the Zhou king.

sentences.zh: 況國家道隆殷周，孤德卑二伯哉！

translations.literal: Moreover the state's way towers above Yin and Zhou; how can my virtue be lower than the two hegemons!
translations.idiomatic: He claimed modesty against the ancient hegemons.

sentences.zh: 其亟止斯議，勿復紛紜。

translations.literal: Hasten to stop this counsel; do not wrangle again.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the flatterers silent.

sentences.zh: 自今敢言，刑茲無赦！

translations.literal: From now whoever dares speak—by this punishment there is no pardon!
translations.idiomatic: He threatened execution for further talk.

sentences.zh: 」乃止。

translations.literal: Thereupon it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The court fell quiet.

sentences.zh: 勒又下書曰：「今大亂之後，律令滋煩，其採集律令之要，為施行條制。

translations.literal: Le again issued an order saying, "Now after great chaos statutes and orders have multiplied annoyingly; gather the essentials of statutes and orders into implementing regulations."
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a digest of laws after the chaos.

sentences.zh: 」於是命法曹令史貫志造《辛亥制度》五千文，施行十餘歲，乃用律令。

translations.literal: Thereupon he ordered legal clerk Guan Zhi to compose the 《Xinhai institutions》 in five thousand characters, implementing them more than ten years before using full statutes and orders.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Zhi drafted the 《Xinhai institutions》—five thousand clauses enforced for a decade before the court returned to ordinary statute law.

sentences.zh: 晉太山太守徐龕叛降-{于}-勒。

translations.literal: Jin grand warden of Taishan Xu Long rebelled and surrendered to Le -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: Taishan prefect Xu Long defected to Shi Le -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 石季龍及張敬、張賓、左右司馬張屈六、程遐文武等一百二十九人上疏曰：「臣等聞有非常之度，必有非常之功；

translations.literal: Shi Jilong and Zhang Jing, Zhang Bin, left and right marshals Zhang Quliu, Cheng Xia, civil and military in one hundred twenty-nine persons submitted a memorial saying, "We your servants have heard that where there is extraordinary measure there must be extraordinary merit;
translations.idiomatic: A hundred twenty-nine officials memorialized for the throne.

sentences.zh: 有非常之功，必有非常之事。

translations.literal: where there is extraordinary merit there must be extraordinary affair."
translations.idiomatic: They argued merit demands a new title.

sentences.zh: 是以三代陵遲，五伯迭興，靜難濟時，績侔睿-{后}-。

translations.literal: Therefore the three dynasties declined and the five hegemons arose in turn, stilling disaster and aiding the age, deeds matching wise consorts -{hou}-.
translations.idiomatic: They invoked the five hegemons' precedent -{hou}-.

sentences.zh: 伏惟殿下天縱聖哲，誕應符運，鞭撻宇宙，弼成皇業，普天率土，莫不來蘇，嘉瑞徵祥，日月相繼，物望去劉氏、威懷-{于}-明公者十分而九矣。

translations.literal: We humbly consider that the hall's Heaven-sent sagely wisdom answered tallies and fortune, scourging the universe, assisting the imperial enterprise; all within heaven and earth none did not revive; auspicious omens followed month on month; creatures' hopes left the Liu house and turned to the enlightened duke nine tenths -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: They tallied omens and popular desire -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 今山川夷靜，星辰不孛，夏海重譯，天人系仰，誠應升御中壇，即皇帝位，使攀附之徒蒙寸尺之潤。

translations.literal: Now mountains and rivers are level and still; stars show no baleful comets; summer seas send repeated translators; Heaven and men hang in dependence—truly it is fitting to ascend the middle altar and assume the emperor's throne, letting clinging followers receive inch-scale moisture.
translations.idiomatic: They begged him to mount the throne.

sentences.zh: 請依劉備在蜀、魏王在鄴故事，以河內、魏、汲、頓丘、平原、清河、鉅鹿、常山、中山、長樂、樂平十一郡，幷前趙國、廣平、陽平、章武、渤海、河間、上黨、定襄、范陽、漁陽、武邑、燕國、樂陵十三郡，合二十四郡、戶二十九萬為趙國。

translations.literal: We beg, following Liu Bei in Shu and the Wei king at Ye precedent, to take Henei, Wei, Ji, Dunqiu, Pingyuan, Qinghe, Julu, Changshan, Zhongshan, Changle, Leping eleven commanderies together with the former Zhao commandery, Guangping, Yangping, Zhangwu, Bohai, Hejian, Shangdang, Dingfan, Fanyang, Yuyang, Wuyi, Yan state, Leling thirteen commanderies—twenty-four commanderies in all, two hundred ninety thousand households—as the Zhao state.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to follow the precedents of Liu Bei in Shu and the Wei king at Ye, combining eleven commanderies—Henei, Wei, Ji, Dunqiu, Pingyuan, Qinghe, Julu, Changshan, Zhongshan, Changle, and Leping—with thirteen more, among them old Zhao, Guangping, Yangping, Zhangwu, Bohai, Hejian, Shangdang, Dingfan, Fanyang, Yuyang, Wuyi, Yan, and Leling, for twenty-four commanderies and two hundred ninety thousand households to be chartered as the Zhao state.

sentences.zh: 封內依舊改為內史，準《禹貢》、魏武復冀州之境，南至盟津，西達龍門，東-{于}-於河，北至於塞垣。

translations.literal: Within the fief as before convert to interior stewards, aligning with 《Tribute of Yu》 and Cao Cao's restoration of Jizhou borders, south to Meng ford, west reaching Dragon Gate, east to the great river, north to the frontier wall -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: Interior counties would answer to stewards; borders would follow 《Tribute of Yu》 and Cao Cao's old Jizhou map—south to Mengjin, west to Longmen, east to the Yellow River, north to the long wall -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 以大單-{于}-鎮撫百蠻。

translations.literal: Use the great Chanyu to pacify the hundred barbarians -{yu}-.
translations.idiomatic: They reserved the Chanyu title for steppe affairs -{yu}-.

sentences.zh: 罷幷、朔、司三州，通置部司以監之。

translations.literal: Abolish Bing, Shuo, and Si three provinces, comprehensively set department offices to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: They merged overseer provinces into a new bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 伏願欽若昊天，垂副羣望也。

translations.literal: We humbly hope you will reverently accord with august Heaven and answer the host's hopes."
translations.idiomatic: They closed with a plea to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 」勒西面而讓者五，南面而讓者四，百僚皆叩頭固請，勒乃許之。

translations.literal: Le toward the west declined five times, toward the south four times; the hundred officials all knocked their heads firmly begging; Le then consented.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Le feigned five western and four southern refusals, then accepted the crown.
